concerns.text: Task T010.1 (Execute MaxMin Sampling) is marked [ ] (Pending) but is a hard dependency for T011.5 (Split Dataset) and T019 (Fingerprints). Without this task, the diverse dataset required for the baseline and RF models cannot be generated, blocking the entire pipeline.

Task T014.5 (Extract Test Set Predictions) is marked [ ] (Pending). This task is a hard block for T015 (Calculate Baseline Metrics) and T021.1 (Wilcoxon Test). Without extracting the baseline predictions for the held-out test set, the statistical comparison (FR-005) cannot be performed.

Tasks T019.1 (Split Fingerprints), T020 (Model Training), and T020.1 (Evaluate on Test Set) are all marked [ ] (Pending). These are required to implement FR-004 (Train RF models) and FR-005 (Statistical comparison). The pipeline cannot validate the non-linear model against the baseline without these.

All implementation tasks for User Story 3 (SHAP, mapping, LNAI, Report) are marked [ ] (Pending). This leaves FR-006 (SHAP values) and FR-007 (Map bits to substructures) unimplemented, failing to address the core 'Non-Additivity Interaction Mapping' research question (Constitution VI).

Reviewer concern tasks (T033, T057, T058, T059) addressing measurement uncertainty and conformational limitations are marked [ ] (Pending). These are critical for satisfying FR-008 (Log data quality metrics) and the plan's explicit requirement to report missing uncertainty data.

Task T010 (Define MaxMin Strategy) is marked [X] (Complete) but is logically impossible to complete before T009 (Preprocess) and T010.1 (Execute) are finished, as the strategy depends on the experimental ratio and missing covariate list calculated in T009. This is a stale status flag.

Task T008 (Data Download) is marked [X] (Complete) but T010.1 (Execute MaxMin) is pending. The download task description implies it fetches 5000 CIDs, but the pipeline logic requires the MaxMin execution to actually produce the diverse subset. Marking T008 complete while the downstream processing is pending creates a false sense of progress.
